name: find_items
summary: Find items anywhere: on the ground, in containers and machines, carried by players, machine stock and silo stores. Each with quantity, location, holders and distance, nearest first or by reference id. 10 per page. Read only.

help.text: Each item reports quantity (stack size, else 1), location, held_in (holders from its own slot outwards), the outermost holder's position, and distance from the player. Sorted nearest first. item_totals sums them by type. Narrow a big world with prefab (exact), prefabs (several exact names, one call for all) or prefab_contains, which read only the items of those prefabs; location (ground: loose in the world; player: carried; stored; machine_stock) and an area: min and max, or near with radius_m (for a machine's stock, where the machine stands). group_by sums them instead (topic groups); exclude_in_use leaves out parts a device is using and counts them in in_use_left_out.
help.keys: items, count, total, offset, limit, has_more, local_player {reference_id, display_name, position}, in_use_left_out.

groups.summary: group_by: sums per holder and prefab, or per prefab.
groups.text: group_by holder: each entry of items is {prefab_name, display_name, reagent (a working load with no ingot), quantity, entries, location, holder {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, position, distance_m}, one prefab's stacks (or a machine's stock, a silo's entries) in one outermost holder, summed; loose items of a prefab make one group with holder null and no position. group_by prefab: {prefab_name, display_name, reagent, quantity, entries, holders (distinct outermost holders)}. Groups come in the order of their first entry (order), and limit, offset, total and has_more page the groups. item_totals splits a prefab's total by place instead.

prefab.description: The whole prefab name, any case, as place_structure and describe_prefab take it ('StructureFrame' is not 'StructureFrameCorner'); with prefab_contains both must match.

prefab_contains.description: Part of the prefab name, any case ('IngotIron', 'Ore', 'Battery').

name_contains.description: Part of the shown name, any case ('Iron Ingot').

location.description: ground, player, stored, machine_stock or silo; default any (see items).

within_id.description: Only items inside this thing at any depth, and its machine stock or silo store.

min.description: Box corner, [x, y, z] m; with max: only items whose outermost holder (a machine's stock: the machine) stands in the box.

near.description: A point, [x, y, z] m; with radius_m: only items whose outermost holder is within radius_m of it.

near_player_m.description: Only things whose outermost holder is within this many metres of the player.

group_by.description: Sum the entries instead of listing each: holder, per outermost holder and prefab; prefab, per prefab.

exclude_in_use.description: Default false: true leaves out parts a device is using (a running filter's filters, chips in their holders) and what is inside them (slots/in_use).

x-paging.order: order nearest (default): nearest the player first (no position last), then by name, items before stock before silo entries, then reference id; order reference_id: lowest reference id first (stock: its machine's; a silo entry: its silo's), then by name, items before stock before silo entries
